title: Telecom Statement 1.0: fraud signals (FraudPreventionAndDetection)
description: Point-in-time identity and account-takeover signals for onboarding, payee changes, high-value payments and logins. Field meanings follow GSMA CAMARA (KYC Match, KYC Tenure, SIM Swap, Device Swap, Call Forwarding Signal, Device Roaming Status), so a TIP can serve the same answers as Open Gateway APIs. Identity is checked by matching the claims the TIU sends; the operator's stored name, date of birth, address and Aadhaar data are never returned. Recency is given in bands, never timestamps. Valid for minutes, not days.

dataLife.description: At most 24 hours: the signals go stale quickly.

validUntil.description: After this moment the TIU must not rely on the signals and should request a new statement.

kycMethod.description: How the current subscriber's KYC was done. The category only: never the document, the Aadhaar number or eKYC attributes (Aadhaar Act).

simChange.description: CAMARA SIM Swap: the last time the SIM or eSIM profile bound to the number changed (replacement, swap or new eSIM download).

deviceChange.description: CAMARA Device Swap: the last time the device (IMEI) using the SIM changed.

portIn.description: When the number was last ported in to this operator (NEVER: it was never ported).

portOut.description: Whether a port-out request (a UPC, the unique porting code) is pending.

callForwarding.description: CAMARA Call Forwarding Signal: forwarding is a common way to intercept OTP calls. Whether it is on, never the forwarded-to number.

conditionalActive.description: Forwarding when busy, unanswered or unreachable.

roaming.description: Optional. CAMARA Device Roaming Status, without the country.

regulatoryFlags.description: DoT's own indicators, relayed only where DoT permits it, so lenders don't receive conflicting values from two sources.

mnrlListed.description: The number is on DoT's Mobile Number Revocation List (disconnected, e.g. for failed re-verification or cyber-fraud).

financialFraudRiskIndicator.description: DoT's Financial Fraud Risk Indicator for the number.

kycTenure.description: CAMARA KYC Tenure: how long the number has belonged to the current subscriber.

numberReassignedWithin.description: When the number was last reassigned to a new subscriber after disconnection (NEVER: first subscriber).

kycMatch.description: Present when the TIU sent identity claims. CAMARA KYC Match: each claim is compared with the operator's KYC record, and only the result is returned.

nameMatchScore.description: Similarity of the full name (0-100), by the standard's normative algorithm (transliteration-aware, case- and spacing-insensitive).

matchResult.description: NOT_PROVIDED: the TIU sent no claim for it. NOT_AVAILABLE: the operator has no value to compare.
